article: How to use Windows Snipping Tool
scope: Compared the complete Japanese source and all twelve translations, current screenshot/video shortcuts, capture modes, save behavior, version qualifications, screenshot asset, metadata, and Microsoft references.
findings: Added the current `Win + Shift + R` video-recording shortcut and clarified `Win + Shift + S` for screenshots.
Updated screenshot and recording steps to the current capture overlay and Record > New flow.
Qualified UI and save behavior as version/settings dependent and labeled the screenshot as Japanese UI.
Removed duplicate date metadata and added lastmod.
